command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.

echo "== staged bytes must match their pins =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged file does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
NOK=$(sha256sum -c --ignore-missing pins.sha256 2>/dev/null | grep -c ': OK$')
printf 'pinned_files_verified\t%s\n' "$NOK"
test "$NOK" -eq 3 || { echo "FAIL: verified $NOK pinned files, expected 3"; exit 1; }

echo "== cmdstan compiles every model, so the toolchain has to be here =="
# Checked before anything else: a missing compiler otherwise surfaces as an opaque make error
# several minutes in.
for t in g++ make; do
  command -v "$t" >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL: $t absent -- cmdstan cannot build a model"; exit 1; }
  printf '  %-6s %s\n' "$t" "$(command -v $t)"
done
python3 -c "
import cmdstanpy
print('  cmdstan_path  %s' % cmdstanpy.cmdstan_path())
print('  cmdstan       %s' % '.'.join(str(x) for x in cmdstanpy.cmdstan_version()))
print('  cmdstanpy     %s' % cmdstanpy.__version__)
" || { echo "FAIL: cmdstanpy does not import or cannot find cmdstan"; exit 1; }

# python3 -u so a killed run still has its output in command.log.
python3 -u identities.py 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

# Copy diagnostics out BEFORE acting on the exit code, so a failed run leaves its evidence.
cp score.tsv cmdstan-diag.txt 2>/dev/null
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
